feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 8 May 2026 11:25am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 08 May 2026 at 11:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Generally dry, bright and sunny today for most of the island. A risk of a shower developing near the hills. A light breeze, becoming a moderate northerly this evening. Top temperature 14°C.

Becoming cloudier during the night. Minimum temperature of 7°C.


##Outlook##

Generally dry on Saturday with bright or sunny intervals. Moderate to fresh north or northeast wind, strengthening a little later. Temperatures reaching 15°C. Fine and mostly sunny on Sunday.
